MPC reference and input layout update
=====================================

Changes:
- d_min, d_max, and d step width were moved into the left Reference model group,
- the first top row now contains physical plant, HONU plant, t_sim, u_min, u_max, and u step width,
- the second top row contains dt MPC, dt sim, MPC horizon, window samples, n_y, n_u, and line width,
- computational behavior and configuration keys were not changed.
